APPROVE
The extraction keeps the same short-circuit order and per-section logic, `entry` is definitely assigned when the `||` condition is false so it compiles, and removing the nested ifs and boolean operators brings the method's complexity from 25 to about 15; the one thing I couldn't check, since the file isn't available here, is that `resolved` and `direct` really are `Dictionary<string, string>` and `List<string>` as the new helper signatures assume.
